appDesc.message: Set and manage playback resolution on Paramount+ for on-demand videos and live streams, with simple controls and clear feedback.
appDesc.description: The description of the extension shown in the web store and browser extensions page

notConnected.description: Status indicating the extension is not connected to a video stream

resolution.description: Label for the video resolution stat

bitrate.description: Label for the video bitrate stat

qualityControl.description: Header for the section where users control the video quality

autoDefault.description: Button label to switch to automatic video quality

forceMaxQuality.description: Button label to force the highest available video quality

prefers1080p.description: Sub-label indicating that force max quality prefers 1080p or higher

availableQualities.description: Header for the list of specific video qualities a user can choose from

settingsSaved.message: Settings saved. Changes may take a few seconds...
settingsSaved.description: Notification message shown when user changes settings

updatingQuality.message: Updating quality... buffer may take 10-20 seconds to clear.
updatingQuality.description: Longer notification message explaining that video quality updates take time

leaveReview.message: Find it useful? Leave a review
leaveReview.description: Prompt asking the user to review the extension

supportMyWork.description: Ko-Fi support link title and accessible label

supportMyWorkCta.description: Compact visible Ko-Fi support label. Keep short enough for the popup header.

advanced.description: Header for the advanced network settings section

enableRetries.description: Label for the network retries toggle

enablePrefetch.description: Label for the prefetch buffer toggle

advancedRetriesDesc.description: Description explaining what network retries do

advancedPrefetchDesc.description: Description explaining what the prefetch buffer does

locationNoticeTitle.description: Title for a warning shown when Paramount+ may be hiding quality options because location permission is denied

locationNoticeBody.message: Paramount+ may hide resolution options for some titles or live events when site location is blocked. Request access here, then refresh playback.
locationNoticeBody.description: Warning shown when quality options are unavailable and location permission is denied

requestLocationAccess.description: Button label that asks Paramount+ to show the browser's location permission prompt

locationAccessGranted.message: Location allowed. Refresh playback if quality options do not appear.
locationAccessGranted.description: Toast shown after the user grants location access

locationPromptUnavailable.message: Open Paramount+ site settings and allow location, then refresh playback.
locationPromptUnavailable.description: Toast shown when the browser cannot show the location permission prompt
